description: §19.16.2 (S430 round 5, F1) — a deferred statement that reads a name (re)declared LATER in its enclosing block chain is E-DEFER-LATER-SHADOW: shadowing a file-level `x` (shadow — would silently read "inner" instead of "outer"), the TDZ variant behind an early return (tdz — would throw ReferenceError from the finally), a later declaration in an ENCLOSING block (outerChain), and a destructured later declaration (destructured). Four occurrences.
rationale: §19.16.2: a deferred statement sees only the bindings in scope at the `defer`; a read of a name a later let/const/lin declaration in its block chain (re)binds SHALL be rejected (fail closed) rather than capture the later binding.
